Name: pwsh.exe
CommandLine:
"C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe" -Command "try { [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch {}
$stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $outDir = Join-Path (Get-Location) \"Reports\hid-io-triage-$stamp\"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $outDir -Force | Out-Null; $since = (Get-Date).AddHours(-6); $terms = 'WUDF|WUDFHost|HostTimeout|HID|I2C|Touch|Touchpad|TrackPoint|Keyboard|Input|TextInput|Terminal|Console|conhost|OpenConsole|PowerShell|pwsh|claude|WindowsTerminal|Win32k|Kernel-PnP|UserPnp|power|sleep|wake|stall|timeout|hang|crash|fault|failed'; function Save-Json($name,$obj,$depth=6){ $obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth $depth | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $outDir $name) -Encoding UTF8 }; $logs = @('System','Application','Microsoft-Windows-DriverFrameworks-UserMode/Operational','Microsoft-Windows-UserPnp/DeviceInstall','Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-PnP/Configuration','Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational','PowerShellCore/Operational','Microsoft-Windows-KeyboardFilter/Admin','Microsoft-Windows-KeyboardFilter/Operational'); $summary = @(); foreach($log in $logs){ try { $events = @(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName=$log; StartTime=$since} -ErrorAction Stop); $hits = @($events | Where-Object { $_.ProviderName -match $terms -or $_.Message -match $terms -or $_.Id -in 41,219,267,1000,1001,6008,7000,7001,7009,7011,7023,7031,7034 } | Select-Object TimeCreated,LogName,ProviderName,Id,LevelDisplayName,@{n='Message';e={($_.Message -replace '\s+',' ').Substring(0,[Math]::Min(600,($_.Message -replace '\s+',' ').Length))}}); Save-Json (($log -replace '[\\/]','_') + '.json') $hits 5; $summary += [pscustomobject]@{Log=$log; Total=$events.Count; Hits=$hits.Count; Error=$null} } catch { $summary += [pscustomobject]@{Log=$log; Total=$null; Hits=$null; Error=$_.Exception.Message} } }; $commands = [ordered]@{}; foreach($pair in @(@('powercfg-a','/a'),@('powercfg-requests','/requests'),@('powercfg-lastwake','/lastwake'),@('powercfg-waketimers','/waketimers'),@('powercfg-wakearmed','/devicequery wake_armed'))){ $name=$pair[0]; $args=$pair[1]; $commands[$name] = (cmd.exe /c \"powercfg $args\" 2>&1 | Out-String) }; Save-Json 'powercfg.json' $commands 4; $pnp = Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object { $_.Status -ne 'OK' -or $_.InstanceId -match 'SNSL002D|VEN_ELAS|LEN032A|LEN0071|VID_06CB|VID_04F3|7E78|7E50|HID|Keyboard|Mouse|BTHLEDEVICE' -or $_.FriendlyName -match 'Touch|TrackPoint|Keyboard|Mouse|HID|I2C|Elliptic|ELAN|Fingerprint' } | Select-Object Class,FriendlyName,InstanceId,Status,Problem; Save-Json 'pnp-input-and-problems.json' $pnp 5; $power = Get-CimInstance -Namespace root\wmi -ClassName MSPower_DeviceEnable | Where-Object { $_.InstanceName -match 'SNSL002D|7E78|VEN_ELAS|LEN0071|LEN032A|VID_06CB|HID|BTHLE' } | Select-Object InstanceName,Enable; Save-Json 'mspower-device-enable.json' $power 4; $procTerms = 'WindowsTerminal|OpenConsole|conhost|pwsh|powershell|claude|codex|node|bun|npx|cmd|AutoHotkey|PowerToys|Keyboard|Razer|Logi|Options|SetPoint|ETD|Elan|Lenovo|Vantage|Bome|TouchOSC|TextInput|ctfmon|TabTip|InputApp'; $procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match $procTerms -or $_.CommandLine -match $procTerms } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine; Save-Json 'processes-terminal-input-tooling.json' $procs 5; Save-Json 'summary.json' ([pscustomobject]@{Timestamp=(Get-Date).ToString('o'); Since=$since.ToString('o'); OutDir=$outDir; Logs=$summary; ProcessCounts=($procs | Group-Object Name | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object Count,Name); PnpProblemCount=@($pnp | Where-Object Status -ne 'OK').Count}) 6; Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $outDir 'summary.json') -Raw"
